properties.statement:
Measured on design dbf39096640c196e (reasoning_report, 2026-10-26):
(1) Every element except publication reads contested, and none reads refuted. That is the right picture for a fact dispute before trial (dec:idea-an-objection-resting-on-evidence-contests-or-refutes).
(2) req:tx-bennet-dep-264 and req:tx-williamson-dep-67 contest each other, and the reply resting on one of them reads unknown. A real weak point surfaced with no one looking for it.
(3) req:obj-pac-not-palin is listed under `unsupported`. The trial agent had inferred that objection rather than taken it from a filing.
These are the read-back behaviours a lawyer's use most depends on. A regression in any of them should fail a test.
